body.html: Resort Baan Fahsai Daosuay (the Thai name is Baan Fahsai Daosuay) is a small budget garden resort in Nong Phok District, Roi Et Province, at 277 Moo 9 · It's a small property of about 8 rooms set in a garden — not a big hotel or a design statement — but it sells the one thing it does well, a location in the Nong Phok district town, the starting point of the route up to Phra Maha Chedi Chai Mongkol at Wat Pha Nam Thip · It suits drivers who come to pay respects at the chedi and want to stay nearby, rather than running back to central Roi Et over 60 kilometres away.

The rooms are simple air-conditioned rooms with a private bathroom and shower, satellite TV, a minibar and fridge, a tea/coffee maker, free bottled water and free Wi-Fi · What sets it apart from a typical district-town guesthouse is that it's a garden resort with a quiet, restful feel and some greenery to sit out in, which works nicely for a relaxed overnight stay · The in-room kit is basic rather than plush, so it suits travellers who want a clean place to sleep at a budget price and aren't expecting city-hotel facilities.
"A small resort in a garden, quiet and peaceful, perfect for a stopover before heading up to Phra Maha Chedi Chai Mongkol · the A/C room was cold and there's easy parking."

Location is the main reason people stay here · Nong Phok is the gateway to Phra Maha Chedi Chai Mongkol at Wat Pha Nam Thip Thep Prasit Wararam, the huge white-and-gold chedi on Khao Khiao that's a landmark of Roi Et · From the district town it's another 10–15 kilometres up the hill to the temple · The area around the resort is the district town, with restaurants, cafes and convenience stores for finding food on foot, including For U Cafe & Bistro nearby · There's parking at the resort, handy for anyone driving the upper-Isan route via Roi Et–Phon Thong–Nong Phok.

To be straight with you, per real guest reviews: this is a newer place with only a few reviews so far, with an average of around 6.0 from 6 Agoda reviews, so that figure isn't yet a firm read · It's a small resort in a small district, so there are limitations worth knowing before you book · There's no pool, no lift, and breakfast isn't guaranteed · With few rooms and a small team, it can be harder to reach at times than an in-town hotel · It's worth calling to confirm your room and ask about breakfast and late check-in before you travel, since it's a small property.

In short: if you're planning to visit Phra Maha Chedi Chai Mongkol and want a quiet garden stay near the route up the hill, for a few hundred baht — Resort Baan Fahsai Daosuay is a fitting choice for a single night · It stands out for its location and garden feel rather than for being new or fully equipped · It suits drivers, couples and small families visiting the chedi and touring upper Isan more than anyone wanting a central Roi Et stay with full facilities.

A tip for planning a stay here: head up to Phra Maha Chedi Chai Mongkol in the morning for the best light and the cool air on the hill, then come back down to relax at the resort in the afternoon · Fill up on fuel and pick up food in the Nong Phok district town before the climb, as options at the top are limited · And because it's a small resort, book and confirm your room ahead, especially over long weekends and festival periods when crowds come to pay respects.

faqTitle: FAQ — Resort Baan Fahsai Daosuay, Nong Phok

faq.q: Where is Resort Baan Fahsai Daosuay, and how close is Phra Maha Chedi Chai Mongkol?
faq.a: Resort Baan Fahsai Daosuay (Baan Fahsai Daosuay) is at 277 Moo 9, Nong Phok District, Roi Et Province · It's in the Nong Phok district town, the starting point for the climb to Phra Maha Chedi Chai Mongkol (Wat Pha Nam Thip) · From the town it's another 10–15 km up the hill to the temple · It's about 60 km from central Roi Et via the Roi Et–Phon Thong–Nong Phok route.

faq.q: How much does Resort Baan Fahsai Daosuay cost, and what rooms are available?
faq.a: Rates start from approx. ฿650/night for a Standard Room · The roomier Twin, Deluxe and Family rooms run about ฿750–฿1,050 · Prices vary by season and room type, so compare Agoda and Trip.com before booking, and since it's a small property, call to confirm your room ahead.

faq.q: Who is Resort Baan Fahsai Daosuay best for?
faq.a: It's best for drivers visiting Phra Maha Chedi Chai Mongkol, couples and small families who want to stay near the route up the hill rather than driving back and forth from the city · It stands out for its location and quiet garden setting · It's less suited to anyone wanting a central Roi Et stay near Bueng Phlan Chai or the Roi Et Tower.

faq.q: What facilities does Resort Baan Fahsai Daosuay have?
faq.a: The A/C rooms have satellite TV, a minibar and fridge, a tea/coffee maker, free bottled water, a private bathroom with shower and free Wi-Fi · There's a garden, parking and a separate smoking area · There's no pool or lift, and breakfast should be checked before booking · Pets are not allowed.

faq.q: What are the reviews of Resort Baan Fahsai Daosuay like?
faq.a: It's a newer place that still has few reviews, with an average of around 6.0 from 6 Agoda reviews, so that figure isn't a firm read yet · The reviews that exist praise the quiet garden setting and the location near the great chedi · Note that it's a small resort with few rooms and limited facilities.

faq.q: Is it easy to drive here, and is there parking?
faq.a: It's convenient for self-drivers · The resort has parking and sits on the Roi Et–Phon Thong–Nong Phok route · It's worth filling up on fuel and buying food in the Nong Phok district town before driving up the hill to Phra Maha Chedi Chai Mongkol, as options at the top are limited.
